Package com.monkey.ultimatebot.api.model.runtime

Record Class BotSnapshot

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.monkey.ultimatebot.api.model.runtime.BotSnapshot
Record Components:
ownerUUID - owner UUID associated with this bot slot
botUUID - runtime bot entity UUID, may be null when unavailable
botMode - lifecycle and ownership mode
difficulty - current difficulty
minDifficulty - minimum allowed difficulty
maxDifficulty - maximum allowed difficulty
combatMode - selected combat mode
combatTuning - resolved combat tuning
customizedCombatTuning - whether the resolved tuning is a player or API override
follow - current follow state
combat - current combat state
totemCount - current totem count
minTotemCount - minimum allowed totems
maxTotemCount - maximum allowed totems
targetUUID - primary target UUID, when available
targetUUIDs - full target set (for multi-target modes)
source - origin of bot creation (core/api)
attackBots - whether this bot can target other managed bots
targetMode - categories of living entities this bot may attack
explosionBlockDamage - whether bot explosions may destroy terrain
teamOwnerUUIDs - complete owner set for a shared team bot
botNameTemplate - configured bot name template
botSkinSource - configured skin source
minArmor - minimum configured armor tier
maxArmor - maximum configured armor tier
armor - current armor tier
blastProtection - per-piece blast-protection state
changeableFollow - whether GUI follow changes are allowed
changeableCombat - whether GUI combat changes are allowed
changeableBlast - whether GUI blast changes are allowed
changeableArmor - whether GUI armor changes are allowed
changeableTotem - whether GUI totem changes are allowed
changeableDifficulty - whether GUI difficulty changes are allowed
changeableCombatMode - whether GUI combat-mode changes are allowed
spawnLocation - configured spawn location, when explicit
killMessage - configured custom kill message, when present
equipmentSlots - persistent equipment-slot overrides
